proof:
lemma time_deriv_time_deriv_electricField_of_isExtrema {A : ElectromagneticPotential d}
    {𝓕 : FreeSpace}
    (hA : ContDiff ℝ ∞ A) (J : LorentzCurrentDensity d)
    (hJ : ContDiff ℝ ∞ J) (h : IsExtrema 𝓕 A J)
    (t : Time) (x : Space d) (i : Fin d) :
    ∂ₜ (∂ₜ (A.electricField 𝓕.c · x i)) t =
      𝓕.c ^ 2 * ∑ j, (∂[j] (∂[j] (A.electricField 𝓕.c t · i)) x) -
      𝓕.c ^ 2 / 𝓕.ε₀ * ∂[i] (J.chargeDensity 𝓕.c t ·) x -
      𝓕.c ^ 2 * 𝓕.μ₀ * ∂ₜ (J.currentDensity 𝓕.c · x i) t := by
  have hJ1 := hJ.differentiable (by simp)
  have hA3 : ContDiff ℝ 3 A := hA.of_le ENat.LEInfty.out
  have hEs j : ContDiff ℝ 2 (A.electricField 𝓕.c t · j) :=
    electricField_apply_contDiff_space hA3 t
  have hEd := fun j k => Space.deriv_differentiable (hEs j) k
  have hB j := @magneticFieldMatrix_contDiff d 2 𝓕.c A hA3 (j, i)
  have hg := congrFun (congrArg (Space.deriv i)
    (funext fun y => ((isExtrema_iff_gauss_ampere_magneticFieldMatrix hA J hJ).mp h t y).1)) x
  simp only [div_eq_mul_inv, Space.deriv_eq_fderiv_basis] at hg
  unfold Space.div at hg
  erw [fderiv_fun_sum (fun j _ => (hEd j j).differentiableAt),
    fderiv_mul_const (LorentzCurrentDensity.chargeDensity_differentiable_space
      hJ1 t).differentiableAt] at hg

  conv_lhs =>
    enter [1, s]
    rw [Time.deriv_euclid (electricField_differentiable_time
      hA3.of_succ _), time_deriv_electricField_of_isExtrema hA J hJ h]
  have hBt j := Space.space_deriv_differentiable_time (i := j) (hB j) x t
  have hJt := @LorentzCurrentDensity.currentDensity_apply_differentiable_time d 𝓕.c J hJ1 x i t
  simp (disch := fun_prop) only [Time.deriv_eq, fderiv_fun_sub, fderiv_const_mul, fderiv_fun_sum, ContinuousLinearMap.sub_apply, ContinuousLinearMap.smul_apply,
    smul_eq_mul, FunLike.coe_sum, Finset.sum_apply,
    ← Space.deriv_eq_fderiv_basis] at hg ⊢
  simp only [← Time.deriv_eq,
    fun j => Space.time_deriv_comm_space_deriv (i := j) (hB j),
    time_deriv_magneticFieldMatrix _ hA3.of_succ,
    Space.fun_deriv_sub _ _ (hEd i _) (hEd _ i),
    fun j => @Space.deriv_commute ℝ d j i _ _ _ (hEs j),
    Finset.sum_sub_distrib, hg, FreeSpace.c_sq, mul_comm 𝓕.ε₀ 𝓕.μ₀, mul_inv_rev,
    div_eq_mul_inv, mul_sub, mul_assoc, inv_mul_cancel_left₀ 𝓕.μ₀_ne_zero, one_mul]

theorem fiberwise_dist_lt_imp_dist_lt_unique_decoding_radius (i : Fin ℓ) (steps : ℕ)
    [NeZero steps] (h_i_add_steps : i.val + steps ≤ ℓ)
    (f : OracleFunction 𝔽q β (h_ℓ_add_R_rate := h_ℓ_add_R_rate) ⟨i, by omega⟩)
  (h_fw_dist_lt : fiberwiseClose 𝔽q β (h_ℓ_add_R_rate := h_ℓ_add_R_rate)
    (i := i) (steps := steps) (h_i_add_steps := h_i_add_steps) (f := f)) :
  hammingClose 𝔽q β (h_ℓ_add_R_rate := h_ℓ_add_R_rate) ⟨i, by omega⟩ f := by
  classical
  let d := fiberwiseDistance 𝔽q β i steps h_i_add_steps f
  obtain ⟨⟨g, hg⟩, _, hd⟩ := Nat.sInf_mem (s :=
    (fun g : BBF_Code 𝔽q β _ => (fiberwiseDisagreementSet 𝔽q β i steps h_i_add_steps f g.1).ncard) '' Set.univ)
    ⟨_, 0, trivial, rfl⟩
  have hb : hammingDist f g ≤ d * 2 ^ steps := by
    rw [show d = _ from hd.symm]
    simp_rw [Set.ncard_eq_toFinset_card', ←Finset.card_fin (2 ^ steps), ←Finset.card_product]
    apply Finset.card_le_card_of_surjOn (fun p => qMap_total_fiber 𝔽q β _ steps
      (Nat.lt_add_of_pos_right_of_le _ _ _ h_i_add_steps) p.1 p.2)
    intro x hx
    refine ⟨(_, _), ?_, (is_fiber_iff_generates_quotient_point 𝔽q β i steps h_i_add_steps x _).mp rfl⟩
    exact Finset.mem_product.mpr ⟨Set.mem_toFinset.mpr
      ⟨x, rfl, (Finset.mem_filter.mp hx).2⟩, Finset.mem_univ _⟩
  have hn : 2 * hammingDist f g < BBF_CodeDistance ℓ 𝓡 i.castSucc := by
    have hh := Nat.mul_le_mul_right (2 ^ steps) (Nat.le_of_lt_succ (ENat.coe_lt_coe.1 h_fw_dist_lt))
    rw [Nat.mul_assoc] at hh
    have hh := (Nat.mul_le_mul_left 2 hb).trans hh
    dsimp [BBF_CodeDistance] at hh ⊢
    rw [Nat.sub_mul, ←Nat.pow_add, ←Nat.pow_add] at hh
    simp only [Nat.sub_add_eq,
      Nat.sub_add_cancel (Nat.le_sub_of_add_le' (h_i_add_steps.trans (Nat.le_add_right ..))),
      Nat.sub_add_cancel (Nat.le_sub_of_add_le' h_i_add_steps)] at hh
    exact Nat.lt_succ_of_le hh
  exact (mul_le_mul_left' (Code.distFromCode_le_dist_to_mem f g hg) 2).trans_lt (ENat.coe_lt_coe.2 hn)
